finite_helper_finding.scope: One owned WOW64 helper and its dedicated OS heap in this unchanged short lifetime only.
raw_validation: Fixed source, ETL, v3 report and sidecar hashes; exact original four producers and three executed reader identities.
Each80-byte heap header, actual PID/TID/time/opcode/version/pointer-width flags, buffer CPU and full payload are checked.
All six original TDH metadata blobs match retained hashes. Property-info names and scalar widths are checked; no version2-to-version0 substitution.
Every payload is reproduced byte-for-byte from its ordered successful native TDH property bytes. Unknown schemas/events, omissions and foreign alloc/free reject.
Foreign statistics retain PID6000 in the header. Their independent payload ProcessId identifies6092; there is no relabeling or silent filtering.

The owned heap has one Create, two exact address/size Alloc records and one Free inside its real operation envelope. The second allocation has no free before StopTrace; actual cleanup begins afterward.
limits: The helper API BOOL is not an original-game HeapFree return or an event field.
All180 heap records have no extended data. Separate stack-walk records elsewhere in the full ETL remain possible; caller-stack association is unverified.
Helper capability does not prove protected-game compatibility, CRT hook approval, original allocation epoch/release, TLS clearing, PTD cleanup or original handle closure.

result_inventory_review.status: counts and raw field distinctions independently reproduced
independent_checks: Loaded the exact compressed school/window sources without copying them. Recounted matching scene/TID/TLS entries and actual raw716-byte EIP values.
Located and compared the raw8-byte saved-BP/return pairs for all191 consumer return sites in the corresponding task terminal_frames.
Authenticated the actual relocated guest NtWait DLL/stub and checked all423 raw contexts/stacks, including owned event, FALSE alertable and NULL timeout.
Recomputed duplicate keys without calling them independent native reads or distinct observation times.
limits: A saved return PC is not current EIP or proof of downstream instruction execution.
The classification covers only the two explicitly declared consumer ranges.
The pending NtWait context EAX is not promoted to the later syscall result.
Gate zero and endpoint locals do not supply the missing continuous instruction/write/ABI trace.

rejection_coverage: false live free with consistent altered payload/property

remaining_first_dependency: Before original PTD cleanup can be proved, bind the current original OS-heap branch, allocation header/epoch and actual freeing caller/result. Continuous result consumption and complete state remain separate prior gaps.
